about_the_game:
Save Granny is a fast-paced, absurd 3D platformer where you play as Daniel, a panicked grandson racing to deliver explosive diarrhea pills to his grandma before she literally blows up.

Jump, and flail your way through a series of chaotic levels, each more unhinged than the last. From underground pipe mazes to floating islands and icy cliffs, every level is a test of speed, reflexes, and your tolerance for absolute nonsense.

Time is always against you, and one wrong move could mean a very messy ending for dear old Granny.

Features:

  • 🚀 11 handcrafted levels, each with unique themes, obstacles, and mechanics

  • 🌪️ Wild environments — including pipe worlds, floating islands, frosty peaks, desert traps, lava towers, and more

  • ⏱️ Time-based gameplay that keeps the pressure constantly rising

  • 🕹️ Tight, responsive 3D platforming built for precision and chaos

  • 💣 Ridiculous premise: deliver anti-explosive diarrhea pills before your grandma explodes

  • 😂 Absurd humor and slapstick energy from start to finish
